caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate wooden table positioned centrally on a plain beige background. The table has a light blue, irregularly-shaped top with a scalloped edge. The base and legs of the table are dark, likely representing stained or painted wood, and feature elaborate carvings including floral motifs, scrollwork, and human face-like figures integrated into the design of the legs. Four curved legs are connected by a decorative stretcher adorned with additional carved ornamentation, including a large centrally placed leaf pattern. The table’s detailed features are rendered with careful shading and highlights, showing the depth and intricacy of the carving, while the plain background isolates and emphasizes the table itself.
title: Ebony, Marble-top Table
